texte.Le taux de fausses alertes et la latence: The false-alert rate and the response latency are the two measures that decide whether an alert still serves any purpose.
texte.Le taux dit ce que le système de managem: The rate states what the declared management system covers of table ZA.#. It states neither that a notified body has seen it, nor that the standard is cited.
texte.Le taux dit la supervision humaine décla: The rate states the human oversight declared against a draft at CEN Enquiry stage. The day the reference is cited, the same work will carry presumption — within the limits of the standard's scope.
texte.Le taux dit une couverture déclarée, pas: The rate states a declared coverage, not a recognised compliance. “#-# compliant” means nothing outside the US federal perimeter.
texte.Le taux par part s'en déduit, et le poid: The rate per share follows from it, and the weight follows the regulatory load: chapter # weighs three times chapter #.
texte.Le taux vaut pour les dix mesures, qui s: The rate holds for the ten measures, which are the same floor under both regimes. What the qualification changes is the supervision — ex ante or ex post — and the ceiling on penalties.
texte.Le texte n'est pas en vigueur : le vert: The text is not in force: green says “declared”, not “required today”.
texte.Le texte produit ressemble à du texte éc: The text produced looks like text written by a trusted human. This is the classic injection flaw, moved up one notch.
texte.Le traitement des non-conformités est-il: Is the handling of non-conformities documented?
texte.Le travail fait ici reste utile, mais il: The work done here remains useful, but it does not stand in for what your supervisory authority expects — and the standard does not cover this case.
texte.Le type d'entité de l'article #, le régi: The entity type of article #, the regime of article #, and the interplay with NIS #.
texte.Le type d'entité ou l'identification au: The entity type or the identification under article # of the directive is not declared. The interplay cannot be guessed.
texte.Le vert de ce parcours dit que tous les: Green on this itinerary says every field expected in a block is filled in. It does not say you are compliant: under DORA, it is the competent authority — ACPR or AMF in France — that assesses, on the record, and its scope goes beyond what a questionnaire covers.
texte.Le vert ne vaut pas présomption de confo: Green carries no presumption of conformity: the draft is not yet cited in the Official Journal.
texte.Le §# définit le risque avec « or ». C'e: §# defines the risk with “or”. It is the most frequently borne label in the table: without this reconciliation, none of the twelve recognised # attachments, and the extraction returned actions with no risk at all.
texte.Le §# n'a d'équivalent dans aucune des d: §# has no equivalent in either ISO standard: it is the piece specific to the regulation, and the one the notified body opens first.
texte.Lecture de la notice d'utilisation reçue: Reading of the instructions for use received
texte.Les # actions suggérées du §#, chacune r: The # suggested actions of §#, each attached to a subcategory of the AI #-# framework and to the risks it addresses. The twelve risks themselves are already in `nist_ai_rmf`: this module does not redeclare them.
texte.Les # mesures de l'annexe A # : retenue: The # controls of Annex A # : retained or ruled out, justified either way, and the implementation status of those retained.
texte.Les # mesures de l'annexe A : retenue ou: The # controls of Annex A: retained or ruled out, and justified either way.
texte.Les AES évaluent les sous-critères à par: The ESAs assess the sub-criteria from the data in the registers of information of article #, paragraph #, of DORA, and may add any other source available to them.
texte.Les AES évaluent si le prestataire rempl: The ESAs assess whether the provider meets ALL the “step #” sub-criteria. They are computed.
texte.Les AES, par l'intermédiaire du comité m: The ESAs, through the Joint Committee, notify the designation and the date from which the provider will actually be subject to oversight activities.
The ESAs, through the Joint Committee, establish, publish and update EVERY YEAR the list of critical ICT third-party service providers at Union level.
texte.Les alertes de TRANSPARENCE (comprendre: TRANSPARENCY alerts (understanding an output) and OVERSIGHT notifications (triggering an intervention) are two different objects: prEN #-# deals with the former.
texte.Les articles # à # : la désignation, le: Articles # to #: the designation, the lead overseer, the powers, and the follow-up by the competent authorities.
Articles # to # do not apply. Article #, paragraph #, second subparagraph, substitutes eight obligations for them, specified by title III of delegated regulation (EU) #/# — fourteen articles.
texte.Les articles # à # s'appliquent, précisé: Articles # to # apply, specified by title II of delegated regulation (EU) #/# — twenty-seven articles.
texte.Les articles du règlement délégué (UE) #: The articles of delegated regulation (EU) #/# that your regime makes enforceable, chapter by chapter.
texte.Les articles sont tenus, la déclaration: The articles are held, the statement of applicability is admissible and the controls retained are implemented.
texte.Les changements apportés aux systèmes d': Are changes made to AI systems planned?
texte.Les changements du système de management: Are changes to the management system planned?
texte.Les changements prédéterminés sont-ils d: Are predetermined changes described in the technical documentation before being implemented?
texte.Les communications internes et externes: Are the internal and external communications needed by the QMS determined?
texte.Les comptes qui peuvent tout : les nomme: The accounts that can do everything: naming them, limiting them, tracing them. Nine more means for an essential entity than for an important one — the widest gap in the framework.
texte.Les compétences et la formation minimale: The minimum competences and training of the persons in charge of the review
texte.Les compétences requises sont-elles déte: Are the required competences determined, and is their presence maintained and evidenced?
texte.Les compétences supposées doivent être c: The competences assumed must be those of the instructions, not those of the team that designed the system.
texte.Les contrats eux-mêmes sont communicable: The contracts themselves are disclosable. A confidentiality clause negotiated with a client is no bar to oversight.
texte.Les contrôles de l'article # — minimisat: The controls of article # — minimisation, rights, sub-processing, review —, each “yes”, “no” or “not applicable”.
texte.Les critères de performance sont dans la: The performance criteria are in the instructions in order to be measured. Without measurement, you have a procedure, not evidence.
texte.Les deux actes délégués du # février # f: The two delegated acts of # February # appear in the corpus in the version adopted by the Commission — C(#) # and C(#) #. Their final numbering in the Official Journal does not: the articles are cited as adopted, and it is the published text that prevails.
texte.Les deux cadres ne portent pas les mêmes: The two frameworks do not carry the same articles — twenty-six on one side, fourteen on the other — and they do not overlap. Until the qualification is done, the “framework” share cannot be measured, and therefore counts as zero.
texte.Les deux dates ne sont pas décoratives :: The two dates are not decorative: without them, nothing shows that the criteria precede the assessment. And anything the scope does not exclude in writing will be audited.
texte.Les deux parts de substituabilité atteig: Both substitutability shares reach the threshold, but in different categories. Depending on whether the same category is required or not, step # is cleared or not — and the delegated act does not say so expressly.
texte.Les deux pièces remises — notice d'utili: The two items handed over — instructions for use, technical documentation: this is where conformity becomes demonstrable.
texte.Les deux révisions ne recouvrent pas le: The two revisions do not cover the same catalogue. Measuring against one while believing you hold the other is the flaw this module refuses.
texte.Les deux sont conservés, distingués par: Both are kept, told apart by their number. Merging them would have made a clause that Annex ZA can target disappear; renaming them would have invented a title the document does not carry.
texte.Les deux sorties — celle du système et c: Both outputs — the system's and the person's — are recorded: without both, there is no measuring later who was right.
texte.Les deux tables de correspondance se lis: The two mapping tables are read backwards: what counts are the TWO rows facing the blank.
texte.Les deux textes s'appliquent, chacun à s: Both texts apply, each on its own basis
texte.Les deux étapes de l'audit, et ce qui fa: The two stages of the audit, and what makes the first one fail.
texte.Les dispositifs d'engagement coûtent de: Engagement devices cost attention: badly calibrated, they create the overload they were meant to avoid.
texte.Les dispositions pertinentes de NIS # so: The relevant provisions of NIS # are set aside
texte.Les dix axes que l'industriel ajoute au: The ten axes that the industrial setting adds to the #-# baseline.
texte.Les dix mesures « tous risques » de l'ar: The ten “all-hazards” measures of article #, paragraph #.
texte.Les dix-huit familles et leurs définitio: The eighteen families and their English definitions, listed in §#; and the industrial overlay of Annex G, which tailors revision # of the catalogue.
texte.Les dix-neuf catégories des quatre fonct: The nineteen categories of the four functions — Govern, Map, Measure, Manage —, each with its state.
texte.Les documents d'accountability, chacun a: The accountability documents, each with a chosen status — including “absent”.
texte.Les données les plus récentes de l'année: The most recent data of the assessment year, or those available by # December of the previous year at the latest.
texte.Les douze risques propres à l'IA générat: The twelve risks specific to generative AI, and how they attach to the subcategories of the framework.
texte.Les délais courent en heures, et la chaî: The deadlines run in hours, and the chain is rehearsed before the incident.
texte.Les délais de la notification initiale,: The deadlines for the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.
texte.Les délais de notification : quatre heur: The notification deadlines: four hours from classification and no later than twenty-four hours from awareness, seventy-two hours for the intermediate report, one month for the final report. No standard sets an hour.
texte.Les déployeurs ont-ils un canal, et ce q: Do deployers have a channel, and does what they report reach anywhere?
texte.Les déterminations de risque restent au: The risk determinations stay in the file kept under prEN #: that is what carries them. The technical documentation carries the design and verification evidence.
texte.Les entités d'un secteur que l'acte sect: The entities of a sector that the sectoral act does not cover remain under the directive, in full.
texte.Les entités financières évaluent l'exist: Financial entities assess the existence of recurring incidents every month.
texte.Les essais d'aptitude à l'utilisation (#: Usability testing (#) is the recommended method, with representative designated persons — not the team that designed the screen.
texte.Les exigences du corps ne s'écartent pas: The requirements of the main body cannot be ruled out: only the Annex A controls can.
The requirements of the main body cannot be ruled out, and some are specific to AI.
texte.Les exigences du système d'IA sont-elles: Are the AI system requirements established, and do they trace up to the essential requirements?
texte.Les exigences imposées aux fournisseurs: Are the requirements imposed on suppliers written down and put under contract?
texte.Les exigences sont-elles tenues à jour q: Are the requirements kept up to date when the design or the intended purpose changes?
texte.Les fournisseurs et composants sont-ils: Are suppliers and components assessed before being selected?
texte.Les huit piliers de la maturité IA, deux: The eight pillars of AI maturity, two questions each, on a No / Partial / Yes scale.
texte.Les indicateurs qui mettent en évidence: Indicators that surface deviations automatically are the difference between monitoring and passive watching.
texte.Les informations collectées sont-elles d: Is the information collected defined, and actually collected?
texte.Les informations documentées sont-elles: Is the documented information updated when the system, the scope or the regulation changes?
texte.Les interfaces, les notifications et les: The interfaces, the notifications and the intervention functions.
texte.Les membres exécutent leurs tâches avec: Members carry out their tasks with competence, care and diligence, WITHOUT ANY BIAS, under the instructions of the lead overseer's coordinator (DORA, article #, paragraph #) and the procedures jointly developed by the European supervisory authorities.
texte.Les mesures de l'annexe A ne sont pas ex: The Annex A controls are not exhaustive: an organisation may design others, or draw on existing sources, if the risk treatment calls for it.
texte.Les mesures que vous avez sélectionnées: Do the measures you have selected belong to the three categories of the standard — retrospective review, alert-triggered intervention, continuous monitoring — or are they designed to meet the criteria of those categories?
texte.Les mesures retenues sont-elles document: Are the measures retained documented — and, for the “other standard” or “other solution” approaches, is what is not covered written down, justified and evidenced?
texte.Les microentreprises et les entités rele: Microenterprises and the entities falling under article #, paragraph #, of regulation (EU) #/#.
texte.Les modalités des tests de pénétration f: The terms of threat-led penetration testing.
texte.Les métadonnées contextuelles sont ce qu: Contextual metadata are what allows the scene to be reconstructed later, if it is disputed.
texte.Les neuf clauses contractuelles de l'art: The nine contractual clauses of article #, paragraph #, and the six additional clauses of paragraph # for critical or important functions. Control A.# calls for agreements; it does not write their content.
texte.Les non-conformités sont-elles traitées,: Are non-conformities handled, and corrective actions followed through to their effectiveness?
texte.Les non-conformités trouvées par la surv: Do the non-conformities found by monitoring reach the handling of non-conformities?
The standards referred to are not in the corpus.
texte.Les objectifs du référentiel ReCyF que v: The objectives of the ReCyF framework that your status makes applicable — twenty for an essential entity, fifteen for an important one.
texte.Les options de configuration de la revue: The configuration options of the review are documented precisely so that you know which one would expose you.
texte.Les options de configuration sont le poi: The configuration options are the tipping point: an option that lets the deployer bring the review down to one person voids the guarantee.
texte.Les parties envisagent l'utilisation de: The parties shall consider the use of standard contractual clauses developed by public authorities for particular services.
texte.Les personnes concernées savent-elles ce: Do the persons concerned know what the QMS expects of them and what their work commits?
texte.Les personnes que vous affectez à la sup: Do the persons you assign to oversight have the competences the instructions for use declare, and have they gone through the training material provided?
texte.Les prestataires qui franchissent l'étap: Providers that clear step # are subject to the “step #” sub-criteria. These are matters of judgement.
texte.Les procédures d'examen, d'essai et de v: The examination, testing and validation procedures.
texte.Les procédures de repli s'oublient : qua: Fallback procedures get forgotten: when the review interface goes down, the review capability goes down with it and nobody had planned for it.
texte.Les procédures de signalement d'un incid: The procedures for reporting a serious incident.
texte.Les procédures disent-elles qui signale,: Do the procedures say who reports, to whom, within what deadline, and with which documents?
texte.Les quarante-deux articles contre lesque: The forty-two articles against which the ISO mapping is established.
texte.Les quatre exclusions de l'article #, pa: The four exclusions of article #, paragraph #, then the quantified thresholds of step #.
texte.Les quatre exigences de l'objectif # — g: The four requirements of objective # — governance, coverage, acceptance of residual risks, review —, each “yes” or “no”, and what each “yes” commits.
texte.Les quatre fonctions, les dix-neuf catég: The four functions, the nineteen categories and the seventy-two subcategories, counted in the document and recounted at every load by the module's guard.
texte.Les quatre obligations des organes de di: The four obligations of management bodies: approve, oversee, answer, train.
texte.Les quatre-vingt-treize mesures de l'ann: The ninety-three Annex A controls and chapters # to #, cited by number.
texte.Les questions de la section RBI n'appara: The questions in the RBI section appear only if you have declared a remote biometric identification system.
texte.Les questions de votre rôle, paragraphe: The questions for your role, clause by clause.
texte.Les ressources nécessaires au SMQ sont-e: Are the resources needed by the QMS determined and provided?
texte.Les ressources, les compétences, et la c: Resources, competences, and communication — including the communication made for regulatory purposes.
texte.Les risques nouveaux ou émergents détect: Are new or emerging risks detected in service handled and fed back to the risk management system?
texte.Les risques pesant sur le fonctionnement: Are the risks bearing on the operation of the QMS itself identified and handled?
The risks bearing on the operation of the management system itself, and the quality objectives.
texte.Les risques qu'aucune mesure de l'annexe: The risks that no Annex A control of ISO/IEC # addresses directly.
texte.Les résultats d'essai, pas la descriptio: The test results, not the description: a described architecture is not a validated architecture.
texte.Les rôles et autorités sont-ils attribué: Are roles and authorities assigned, and does the person in charge of regulatory compliance have the authority to stop a placing on the market?
texte.Les scénarios s'écrivent par TYPE de sor: Scenarios are written by TYPE of output and by cause-and-effect chain, not by deployment instance: a list of customers is not a list of scenarios.
